name: brand-forest-green
usage: Primary brand colour. Logo disc, primary buttons, hero bands, footer. Pair with on-brand text.

name: brand-forest-green-hover
usage: Hover and pressed state of brand-forest-green fills. on-brand text still passes (5.9:1 or more).

name: brand-harvest-gold
usage: Accent fill: key numbers, highlights, the logo's furrow arcs and leaf, secondary call-to-action fills with on-gold text. Never text on light surfaces (2.2:1).

name: brand-cocoa-brown
usage: Secondary brand colour for export, product and premium sections and the logo descriptor line. Text on surface-ivory passes at 9.2:1.

name: brand-leaf-green
usage: Supporting fill for sustainability content, the logo's right leaf, chart series and illustration. Decorative only on light surfaces (2.5:1 on white); never text there.

name: brand-savanna-ivory
usage: Brand ivory: the warm off-white of print, section backgrounds and reversed logo marks.

name: brand-charcoal
usage: Brand near-black for print body text and dark photography overlays.

name: surface
usage: Default page background.

name: surface-ivory
usage: Alternate section background and cards on surface. The brand's signature warm ground.

name: surface-sand
usage: Raised or nested panels, table headers, stat strips on surface-ivory.

name: surface-brand
usage: Hero bands, footer and full-bleed statement sections. Text on it is on-brand.

name: ink
usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-ivory and surface-sand (12.6:1 or more in both themes).

name: ink-muted
usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface, surface-ivory and surface-sand (5.3:1 or more light, 8.2:1 or more dark).

name: ink-brand
usage: Links, eyebrow labels and accent headings on surface and surface-ivory (9.0:1 or more light, 8.4:1 or more dark).

name: ink-gold
usage: Gold-toned text on surface (5.9:1 light) and dark surfaces (7.3:1 or more). Use it where the design wants gold words; never brand-harvest-gold on light.

name: on-brand
usage: Text and icons on surface-brand and brand-forest-green fills (9.0:1).

name: on-gold
usage: Text and icons on brand-harvest-gold fills (7.1:1).

name: line
usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning.

name: line-strong
usage: Form-control borders and meaningful outlines (4.7:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

name: focus-ring
usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element (9.9:1 light, 7.3:1 or more dark).

name: status-success
usage: Success text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or a check icon.

name: status-warning
usage: Warning text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or an icon.

name: status-danger
usage: Error text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or an icon; differs from status-success in lightness, not hue alone.
